# Payal Ponkshe

Payments and fintech operator with 18+ years across Mastercard, Wirecard and regulated financial services. Independent advisor and builder working where enterprise delivery, operating models and AI-enabled systems need to become executable. Current market focus: Agentic Commerce Readiness & Enablement.

Based in Germany. Works across Europe and the UAE in English-first environments, remote or onsite.

## Positioning

Payments · AI · Transformation Execution

Payal's work sits at the point where technology strategy has to become operating reality. Her strongest domain depth is in payments, fintech and financial services; her current hands-on build work spans AI-enabled products, workflow systems and automation.

Current focus: helping businesses understand what needs to change when AI agents move from recommendation toward action, and taking one priority commerce journey far enough to test the implementation pattern.

## Agentic Commerce Readiness & Enablement

Agentic Commerce is treated as a current market transition, not Payal's entire identity and not a bet on one protocol or platform.

The Agentic Commerce Readiness Stack examines eight layers:
- Discoverable
- Interpretable
- Callable
- Authorised
- Transactable
- Fulfillable
- Governable
- Measurable

### Agentic Commerce Launchpad

**Assess — Agentic Commerce Readiness Sprint**
Select one or more commercially important journeys, identify where an agent-mediated experience will break, map architecture and authority gaps, and define a prioritised MVP and 90-day path.

**Prove — Agentic Commerce MVP**
Take one deliberately narrow journey and implement enough of the end-to-end chain to test the data, interfaces, authority, transaction, fulfilment, controls and observability in practice.

**Scale — Agentic Commerce Operating Model**
Translate a proven journey into repeatable internal capability across products, channels, markets and teams.

Agentic Commerce page: https://payalponkshe.com/agentic-commerce

## Broader Services

**Enterprise Delivery & Transformation**
Defined transformation and mobilisation work for complex cross-functional initiatives that need clearer ownership, governance, operating rhythm and implementation momentum.

**AI Workflow & Operating Model**
Workflow prioritisation, future-state design, working proof or prototype where appropriate, architecture/build-vs-buy choices, controls, measurement and implementation backlog.

**Enterprise Delivery & Implementation Acceleration**
For B2B payments, fintech and enterprise-technology companies where customer onboarding or implementation has become slow, bespoke or difficult to scale.
